lines.en: One hour later...
lines.zh: 一小时后……

lines.en: : Mother — I apologize for the intrusion...
lines.zh: : 母亲——抱歉打扰……

lines.en: : But I would like to talk about what transpired here today if you have a moment or two to spare.
lines.zh: : 但若您能抽出片刻,我想谈谈今天在这里发生的事。

lines.en: : Hm...Well at least it’s actually you this time. So how could I refuse if my oldest daughter is asking?
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少这次真的是你。既然是我的长女开口,我又怎能拒绝?

lines.en: : You’ve refused me many times before, Mother.
lines.zh: : 您以前拒绝过我很多次,母亲。

lines.en: : In fact, you were refusing me quite unabashedly just an hour ago when I was attempting to drag my teacher out of the devious scenario you forced him into this time.
lines.zh: : 事实上,就在一小时前,我试图把我的老师从您这次强加给他的阴谋里拖出来时,您还毫不掩饰地拒绝过我。

lines.en: : You seemed quite happy to be involved in that scenario until your sister tried to steal your man from under your nose, dear.
lines.zh: : 在你妹妹企图从你眼皮底下抢走你的男人之前,亲爱的,你看起来还挺乐于参与那场戏的。

lines.en: : I swear — I’m always so surprised by how reluctant you are to take the things you’re entitled to.
lines.zh: : 我发誓——你对自己应得之物的抗拒,总是让我吃惊。

lines.en: : No one is entitled to Sensei, Mother. Not me. Not you. And most definitely not Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 没有谁有权拥有 Sensei,母亲。我没有。您没有。Tsukasa 更没有。

lines.en: : No wonder he sees you as a mother if you’re going to defend him like that. But you seem to be misunderstanding something, dear.
lines.zh: : 你要是打算这样护着他,难怪他把你当母亲看。不过,亲爱的,你似乎误会了什么。

lines.en: : What happened in my office was not an attempt to force your beloved Akira into anything at all. I’m just trying to do what’s best for our family.
lines.zh: : 我书房里发生的事,完全不是要强迫你心爱的 Akira 做什么。我只是在为我们家做最合适的事。

lines.en: : Well, I struggle to understand just what you believe you are doing for this family by asking the man I’ve grown a fondness for to teach both my sister and me about...sex.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我很难理解,您让那个我渐生好感的男人,给我和我妹妹两个人讲……性,这究竟是为这个家做了什么。

lines.en: : You don’t need to hesitate when using that word around me, Touka. You’re at the age now where I’m surprised you can think about anything else at all.
lines.zh: : 在我面前说那个词不必犹豫,Touka。你已经到了那个年纪——我现在惊讶的是你居然还能想别的。

lines.en: : I tend to keep my family out of such fantasies, thank you very much. And even if I am of that age, Tsukasa isn’t.
lines.zh: : 我习惯把家人排除在这类幻想之外,多谢关心。而且就算我到了那个年纪,Tsukasa 也没有。

lines.en: : She is, though. And do you want to know why she is, Touka?
lines.zh: : 可她到了。你想知道她为什么到了吗,Touka?

lines.en: : Not particularly...but if I had to wager a guess, I assume it may have something to do with the fact that you’re moving forward with this archaic tradition of marrying her off.
lines.zh: : 并不特别想……但非要我猜的话,我猜这可能与您正在推进那门把她嫁出去的陈旧传统有关。

lines.en: : Which, with all due respect, I am very disappointed to hear. For I had assumed that-
lines.zh: : 恕我直言,得知此事我非常失望。因为我原以为——

lines.en: : Did you or did you not create an opportunity for your teacher and his subordinate to venture off for some “alone time” during the Christmas party, Touka?
lines.zh: : 圣诞派对上,给你的老师和他的下属制造机会、让他们溜去「独处」,是不是你干的,Touka?

lines.en: : I...that-
: Why? Because I understand kindness, but not the type that involves sending my man off to bed another woman in my own home.
lines.zh: : 为什么?因为我懂得善意——但不包括那种把我男人送进别的女人被窝、还是在我自己家里的善意。

lines.en: : It...is not up to me who Sensei-
lines.zh: : Sensei 和谁……不归我管——

lines.en: : Do you know where he went with her, Touka? Would you like to wager a guess in regard to that as well?
lines.zh: : 你知道他带她去了哪吗,Touka?要不要也猜一猜?

lines.en: : I...assume one of the guest rooms or a...restroom, perhaps? But does the room really-
lines.zh: : 我……猜是某间客房,或者……洗手间?可房间真的重——

lines.en: : He went to your sister’s room.
lines.zh: : 他去了你妹妹的房间。

lines.en: : Then...Then he likely didn’t know it was-
lines.zh: : 那……那他多半不知道那是——

lines.en: : He’s been there before for her studies. And he went there on purpose that night.
lines.zh: : 他为了她的功课去过那里。而且那晚,他是故意去的。

lines.en: : So it wouldn’t be a stretch to believe that she may have witnessed something that sparked this sudden curiosity that night, do you?
lines.zh: : 所以,认为她那晚可能目睹了什么、才点燃这份突然的好奇,并不牵强,你说呢?

lines.en: : R...Regardless of how such curiosity is founded, the fact remains that your actions today have done nothing but exaggerate it.
lines.zh: : 无……无论这份好奇从何而来,事实始终是:您今天的所作所为,只放大了它。

lines.en: : Tsukasa is likely just confused by the idea that she may soon need to marry a man she hasn’t met.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 多半只是被「可能很快要嫁给一个素未谋面的男人」这件事弄糊涂了。

lines.en: : And I have to say, Mother, I’m surprised she knows at all. You’re typically better at keeping secrets than that.
lines.zh: : 而且我得说,母亲,她居然知情,我很惊讶。您守秘密向来比这高明得多。

lines.en: : I am, aren’t I? Yet both of you have managed to figure it out on your own. So either the two of you are very smart, or I’m just getting sloppy.
lines.zh: : 我是高明,不是吗?可你们俩都自己琢磨出来了。所以要么你们俩非常聪明,要么我变马虎了。

lines.en: : Or you’re sowing the seeds of chaos for your own amusement out of jealousy that I have managed to find something that you never could.
lines.zh: : 又或者,您在为自己的乐子播撒混沌的种子——出于嫉妒,嫉妒我找到了您永远找不到的东西。

lines.en: : Which is?
lines.zh: : 那是什么?

lines.en: : Love for someone that was not chosen for me.
lines.zh: : 对一个不是被安排给我的人的爱。

lines.en: : And I imagine that’s why you’re going to ship Tsukasa off as well...so that she can’t find the same thing.
lines.zh: : 而我猜,这也是您要把 Tsukasa 送走的原因……好让她找不到同样的东西。

lines.en: : Is that really what you think of me, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你就是这么看我的吗,Touka?

lines.en: : That I’m just jealous?
lines.zh: : 认为我只是嫉妒?

lines.en: : That I’ve never found love of my own before?
lines.zh: : 认为我从未找到过属于自己的爱?

lines.en: : I am saying that is how it appears...And with how secretive essentially all of your decision-making is, I can’t say I should be blamed for coming to such a conclusion.
lines.zh: : 我说的是,看起来是这样……而您几乎所有的决策都秘而不宣,我得出的这个结论,恐怕怪不到我头上。

lines.en: : If I am to take over for this family, isn’t it time that you stop keeping me in the dark? Have I not proven to you that I am mature enough to hear the truth yet?
lines.zh: : 既然我要接手这个家,您是不是也该别再瞒着我了?我还没向您证明我成熟到足以听取真相吗?

lines.en: : Just speak to me! Stop making me guess!
lines.zh: : 好好跟我说!别再让我猜!

lines.en: : Mature. You won’t even fuck the man you love because you’re nervous about it and you want to talk about being “mature.” Give me a break.
lines.zh: : 成熟。你连你爱的男人都不敢上,因为紧张,然后你想跟我谈「成熟」。饶了我吧。

lines.en: : If it were just me in that room, I may take this bait...But Tsukasa was there as well.
lines.zh: : 如果当时房间里只有我,我或许会咬这个饵……但 Tsukasa 也在场。

lines.en: : And there is simply no way that someone as smart as you would ever think that such a thing is a “good” idea. So you need to be doing it on purpose.
lines.zh: : 而像您这么聪明的人,绝不可能认为那种事是个「好」主意。所以您只能是故意的。

lines.en: : You are the one creating an opportunity this time. Not me. And in your very own house too.
lines.zh: : 这次制造机会的人是您。不是我。而且还是在您自己的家里。

lines.en: : You make me very proud sometimes, Touka. You really do.
lines.zh: : 你有时让我非常骄傲,Touka。真的。

lines.en: : How unfortunate that this is one of those times.
lines.zh: : 多么不幸,这次正是其中之一。

lines.en: : Yes...how unfortunate, indeed. I can’t imagine there’s anything I could say right now that would make you want to join me for a bath, is there?
lines.zh: : 是啊……确实不幸。我想象不出,我现在还能说什么话,会让你愿意陪我洗个澡,对吧?

lines.en: : Not at the moment, no. I came here for the express purpose of asking you to leave Sensei alone — and to sever all of his ties with Tsukasa immediately.
lines.zh: : 眼下没有。我来这里,明确目的就是请您离 Sensei 远点——并立刻切断他和 Tsukasa 之间的一切联系。

lines.en: : Is that for his sake? Or hers?
lines.zh: : 那是为了他?还是为了她?

lines.en: : You seem quite interested in your sister all of a sudden, Touka. You’ve never expressed this much concern for her before. At least not to me. So perhaps you’re the jealous one?
lines.zh: : 你忽然对你妹妹相当上心啊,Touka。你从没表现出过这种程度的关心。至少对我没有。所以,说不定嫉妒的人是你?

lines.en: : Or perhaps all three of us are jealous of one another? It isn’t often we have such a handsome young man roaming around the manor. Of course we’d think things. Want things.
lines.zh: : 又或者,我们三个在互相嫉妒?这么英俊的年轻男人在公馆里转悠,可不多见。我们当然会想。会渴望。

lines.en: : But what if this goes a little deeper than that? What if there’s another possibility for what’s really going on here that I simply...can’t tell you regardless of how much I may want to?
lines.zh: : 可如果事情比那更深一层呢?如果此处真正发生的事,还有另一种可能,而它无论我多想说……都不能告诉你呢?

lines.en: : What if what I’m doing right now is the ultimate sign of love?
lines.zh: : 如果我现在做的,恰恰是爱的终极证明呢?

lines.en: : I’m hard pressed to believe that Tsukasa’s sexual education plays any part in that at all.
lines.zh: : 我很难相信,Tsukasa 的性教育在其中能起任何作用。

lines.en: : It does if he fucks her, dear.
lines.zh: : 如果他上了她,就有作用,亲爱的。

lines.en: : Mother?!!!?!?
: Tsukasa figured things out without being told and has yet to speak to me about it. She’s accepted her duty as a member of the family and is inclined to let things play out without interfering.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 无师自通,而至今没有来找我谈。她已接受了自己作为家族一员的职责,倾向于不干涉、静观其变。

lines.en: : I swear, she’s such a good girl when she isn’t tormenting the staff. Which is precisely why we both know she isn’t going to just ask to go against the family’s wishes.
lines.zh: : 我发誓,只要不折磨佣人,她就是个多好的女孩啊。这也正是你我都知道的原因:她不会开口违背家族的意愿。

lines.en: : That’s not enough, though. If I call the wedding off without reason, that reflects negatively upon us and threatens to disrupt the ecosystem this family has fought so hard to build.
lines.zh: : 但那还不够。如果毫无理由地取消婚约,会有损我们的声誉,并可能扰乱这个家族千辛万苦建立的生态。

lines.en: : It won’t just be her in jeopardy, it will be all of us.
lines.zh: : 到时候陷入险境的不只是她,而是我们所有人。

lines.en: : But if a third party interferes...and she falls for someone outside of our direct sphere of influence, perhaps we won’t need to call off a wedding at all?
lines.zh: : 但如果有个第三方介入……而她爱上了我们直接势力范围之外的人,也许我们根本不必取消婚礼?

lines.en: : Perhaps no one will want one in the first place.
lines.zh: : 也许一开始,就没人想要婚礼。

lines.en: : Then you intend to...give her to Sensei so you don’t have to give her to someone else?! That’s your master plan?!
lines.zh: : 所以您打算……把她交给 Sensei,这样就不用交给别人?!这就是您的锦囊妙计?!

lines.en: : Maybe. Or maybe it’s just one more lie that’s far easier for you to understand than an even harsher truth.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。又或者,这只是又一个谎言——一个比更残酷的真相容易让你理解得多的谎言。

lines.en: : I just...I understand what you mean and...I don’t want her married off at this age either. But surely there must be a way that doesn’t involve her sleeping with my teacher?
lines.zh: : 我只是……我明白您的意思,而且……我也不想她在这个年纪嫁人。但肯定有办法,不必让她和我的老师上床吧?

lines.en: : The two of them could be married, I suppose. Lord knows being married doesn’t mean a couple is having sex. But if they wanted to, it wouldn’t be our place to stop them.
lines.zh: : 我想,他们俩可以结婚。天知道结婚又不代表夫妻就得做爱。但如果他们想,也轮不到我们阻止。

lines.en: : Could she not just...marry one of the staff instead? Why does it have to be him? That’s the part I’m not understanding.
lines.zh: : 她难道不能就……嫁给某个佣人?为什么非得是他?这是我不明白的地方。

lines.en: : You understand, Touka. You just don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 你明白的,Touka。你只是不想明白。

lines.en: : The two of you want the same thing. So what’s a mother to do when that happens? Especially a mother who’s already promised to protect him as well.
lines.zh: : 你们俩想要的是同一件事。所以真到了那一步,一个母亲该怎么办?尤其是一个已经承诺也要保护他的母亲。

lines.en: : There’s only one way to save all of you. And I imagine we’ll all wind up sleeping with him eventually, so what’s the point in holding back now?
lines.zh: : 拯救你们所有人的办法只有一个。而我想,我们最终都会和他上床,那现在克制又有什么意义?

lines.en: : What do you mean you made a promise to “protect him?” Because, last I checked, you’re the one constantly putting him in danger.
lines.zh: : 您说您承诺过「保护他」是什么意思?因为据我所知,不断把他置于险境的人正是您。

lines.en: : So you get upset when your sister speaks of fucking him, but not me. Our bond really is a special one, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 所以,你妹妹说想上他你会恼火,我说却不会。我们的羁绊真是特别,不是吗?

lines.en: : Who is Sensei to you? Why must he be so intrinsically involved in everything?
lines.zh: : Sensei 对您来说到底是什么?为什么他必须和一切有着内在的牵连?

lines.en: : Just a friend, of course. Any other connection is purely coincidental.
lines.zh: : 当然只是朋友。任何其他关联,纯属巧合。

lines.en: : And I’m just supposed to believe that?
lines.zh: : 而我就该信这个?

lines.en: : No. But you’re supposed to accept it. Such is the life of a Tsukioka.
lines.zh: : 不该信。但你该接受。这就是 Tsukioka 家的人生。

lines.en: : If I had known this would be the life I’m meant to lead, I’d have offered myself up instead of Tsukasa and tried my luck elsewhere. I’m not exactly fond of treating people like pieces on a chess board.
lines.zh: : 如果我早知道这就是我命中注定的人生,我会自荐顶替 Tsukasa,去别处碰碰运气。把人当棋盘上的棋子摆弄,我可谈不上喜欢。

lines.en: : Chess is an acquired taste — like wine. No one starts off liking it, but you grow to appreciate its complexities in time. And eventually, it’s hard to live without it.
lines.zh: : 棋是一种后天养成的品味——就像红酒。没有谁一开始就喜欢,但假以时日,你会学会欣赏它的复杂。而最终,没有它你活不下去。

lines.en: : Then perhaps you’ve drunk a bit too much as your movements are suddenly sloppy and unfitting of the woman I am modeled after.
lines.zh: : 那您大概是喝多了——您的手法忽然变得粗糙,配不上我以之为原型的那位女性。

lines.en: : If you think you can handle this better than I can, feel free. I have no qualms with handing over the reins if you’ve come up with your own idea on how to preserve this family.
lines.zh: : 你若觉得你能比我处理得更好,请便。如果你想出了保全这个家族的自家主意,把缰绳交给你,我毫无异议。

lines.en: : That said, however, I imagine that you’ll ultimately arrive at the same place as me.
lines.zh: : 尽管如此,我猜你最终会抵达和我相同的终点。

lines.en: : And soon, you’ll understand just how much easier it would be to keep an eye on him if he was just here.
lines.zh: : 而很快,你就会明白,如果他就在这里,盯着他要容易得多。

lines.en: : If he is here, it will be because he wants to be. Not because one of us has forced his hand.
lines.zh: : 如果他在这里,那是因为他愿意。而不是因为我们中的谁逼他就范。

lines.en: : I don’t disagree with that at all. I’m just tired of everyone I know wanting things and never taking them. It’s all far too nostalgic.
lines.zh: : 这我完全不反对。我只是烦透了——我认识的每个人都在渴望,却从不去拿。这一切都太令人怀念了。

lines.en: : Then let me say this — I will find a way to make him mine. And when I do, this type of behavior will not be tolerated regardless of whether or not you are my mother.
lines.zh: : 那就让我把话放在这里——我会找到办法让他成为我的。而当我做到时,这种行为将不再被容忍,无论您是不是我的母亲。

lines.en: : Aww...you really won’t share? After all I’ve given to you?
lines.zh: : 哎呀……你真的不肯分享?在我给了你这么多之后?

lines.en: : Listen to yourself! You are a married woman! I can’t even begin to think of what Father would say if he heard any of this right now!
lines.zh: : 听听你说的话!你是有夫之妇!我根本不敢想,父亲此刻若听到这些会说什么!

lines.en: : You’re right. I am married.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我已婚。

lines.en: : But we have a long history of concubines in this family...
lines.zh: : 但这个家族纳妾的历史,源远流长……

lines.en: : And if you don’t hurry up, I might be tempted to take one.
lines.zh: : 而如果你不抓紧,我可能会忍不住纳一个。

lines.en: : How would that make you feel, Touka?...
lines.zh: : 那会让你作何感想,Touka?……

lines.en: : Losing your man to your mother?...
lines.zh: : 你的男人被你母亲夺走?……

lines.en: : Better or worse than losing him to Tsukasa?...
lines.zh: : 比起他被 Tsukasa 夺走,哪个更好受?……

lines.en: : I wonder which one of us he’d prefer?
lines.zh: : 我好奇,他更喜欢我们中的哪个?

lines.en: : I’m surprised a righteous fool like you can love him at all when you already know the answer.
lines.zh: : 你这个正直的傻瓜,明明已经知道答案,居然还能爱他,我挺惊讶的。

lines.en: : Mother-
lines.zh: : 母亲——

lines.en: : Hurry up.
lines.zh: : 快去。

lines.en: : I don’t want you becoming an obstacle as well.
lines.zh: : 我不想你也变成障碍。

lines.en: Touka Tsukioka was pissed!
lines.zh: Touka Tsukioka 火大了!

lines.en: It wasn’t every day that someone wanted to fuck the man she- well, actually, it was. But it wasn’t every day that her mother wanted to fuck him! And that was bad!
lines.zh: 想上她那个男——的人可不是天天有。呃,其实,天天都有。但她妈想上他可不是天天有!而这很糟!

lines.en: Or at least she thought it was bad? But similar to Akira, she left every serious conversation with Tsubasa wondering whether or not she’d just been played.
lines.zh: 或者至少她觉得糟?但和 Akira 一样,每次和 Tsubasa 谈完严肃话题,她都会怀疑自己是不是被耍了。

lines.en: And maybe she had!
lines.zh: 也许她确实被耍了!

lines.en: Or maybe she hadn’t. Because Tsubasa wasn’t feeling very ecstatic right now either.
lines.zh: 也许没有。因为 Tsubasa 此刻的心情也说不上多欣喜。

lines.en: And as she stood there in her towel for a solid five minutes, fingers massaging her eyelids as she came to terms with always being seen as the bad guy, she believed for a moment that maybe she was.
lines.zh: 她裹着毛巾站在那里,整整五分钟,手指揉着眼睑,慢慢接受自己永远被视为坏人的事实——有那么一瞬,她甚至相信也许自己真的是。

lines.en: And maybe it was a bad idea to have a man who wore his impurest proclivities on his sleeves like cuff-links be the one to teach her youngest daughter about the birds and the bees.
lines.zh: 也许,让一个把最不洁的癖好像袖扣一样别在袖口的男人,负责给她最小的女儿讲「鸟儿与蜜蜂」的启蒙课,确实是个坏主意。

lines.en: It was pretty safe to say she was going through it. But that was a side of her that needed to stay concealed at the risk of destroying everything.
lines.zh: 可以说,她正经受着煎熬。但那是她必须藏起的一面——哪怕冒着毁掉一切的风险。

lines.en: For if it didn’t, something told her that something else would be destroyed. And that something was far closer to her than that other something. Or something.
lines.zh: 因为若不藏,某种预感告诉她,会有别的东西被毁掉。而那个东西,比另一个东西离她近得多。或者什么的。

lines.en: Neither one of us can tell you what it is because neither one of us knows.
lines.zh: 我们俩谁也无法告诉你那是什么,因为我们俩都不知道。

lines.en: We just know it’s bad and this is good. But it can’t be good if bad things don’t happen. Which makes the bad things less bad and more good.
lines.zh: 我们只知道那个是坏的,这个是好的。可要是坏事不发生,好事也成不了好事。这让坏事没那么坏,反而更好了。

lines.en: Tsubasa Tsukioka was an excellent babysitter — and an even better business partner.
lines.zh: Tsubasa Tsukioka 是一位出色的临时保姆——还是一位更出色的生意伙伴。

lines.en: She’s doing a great job!
lines.zh: 她干得很棒!

lines.en: Her job just sucks.
lines.zh: 只是她的工作很烂。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
